description: Multi-value selection dropdown with chip, delimiter, or checkbox display modes, filtering, grouping, select-all, max selection limit, server-side data provider, and custom item/value templates. Its popup is a TmOverlayPanel with ConstrainHeight: the list is capped at the room left on the resolved side (and at its own CSS max-height), and the cap follows the room in both directions — it regrows as room returns while the panel is open. role=listbox, aria-multiselectable and the stable {Id}-listbox id live on div.tm-multiselect__options, and only while options render. The combobox and the filter point at that id with aria-controls only then; neither emits aria-owns. Loading, error and empty states are siblings (role=status or role=alert). A grouped listbox owns role=group children, each named by its header; an empty group key announces the localized "Other". With no Label and no AriaLabel the listbox is named by aria-labelledby pointing at the combobox. A mobile sheet takes SheetTitle from that same name, and initial focus lands on the filter, or on the listbox itself when filtering is off.

parameters.name: Values
parameters.description: Currently selected values.

parameters.name: ValuesChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the selection changes.

parameters.name: Items
parameters.description: Static list of items. Ignored when DataProvider is set.

parameters.name: DataProvider
parameters.description: Server-side data provider. When set, Items is ignored.

parameters.name: DisplayField
parameters.description: Extracts display text from an item.

parameters.name: ValueField
parameters.description: Extracts the value from an item.

parameters.name: IdField
parameters.description: Extracts a string key for @key and ExcludedIds. Defaults to ValueField.ToString().

parameters.name: GroupField
parameters.description: Extracts a group name for grouped display.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Visual mode for selected items. Default: Chip.

parameters.name: Delimiter
parameters.description: Delimiter string for Delimiter mode. Default: ", ".

parameters.name: Label
parameters.description: Label shown above the component. Also the accessible name of the trigger and of the popup, unless AriaLabel overrides it.

parameters.name: HideLabel
parameters.description: When true, Label is not rendered as a visible label. It stays the accessible name of the trigger and of the popup. Default false, so an existing multi-select still shows its label.

parameters.name: AriaLabel
parameters.description: Accessible name of the trigger and of the popup. Null falls back to Label.

parameters.name: MobilePresentation
parameters.description: How the option popup presents on a narrow viewport. Popover (the default) keeps the anchored popup at every width. Auto follows LayoutMode: a content-height bottom sheet on mobile, the anchored popup otherwise.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: The layout MobilePresentation resolves from. A forced value never measures. Ignored unless MobilePresentation is Auto.

parameters.name: Placeholder
parameters.description: Placeholder text when no items are selected.

parameters.name: Error
parameters.description: Validation error message.

parameters.name: AnnounceError
parameters.description: When true (default), the error message renders with role="alert" so screen readers announce it assertively the moment it appears. Set false when the host moves focus to the invalid field after submit — the error is then read through aria-describedby on the control and the live region would announce the same text a second time. Only the role attribute is dropped; the message, its styling and the aria-describedby link remain. Only safe when the same render that shows the error also moves focus to this control. Keep the default for validation on blur or on input, async/server validation, or when focus stays on the submit button — otherwise the error is not announced at all. With several invalid fields, pair it with a summary (e.g. TmValidationSummary) or focus the first invalid field.

parameters.name: HelpText
parameters.description: Help text shown below when no error is present.

parameters.name: AriaDescribedBy
parameters.description: Extra ids the trigger describes, appended to the ones this component owns (its error or help text). A host uses it for a message it renders itself — the modeling inspector's "reference may be stale" hint — so the trigger announces exactly what is on screen.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: HTML id attribute.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class(es).

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Disables the component. The trigger carries aria-disabled, the cursor turns not-allowed and the box paints the disabled surface (--tm-color-gray-50 / --tm-text-disabled, the same paint as .tm-input[disabled]). Since KG-008 (decision O1) the disabled control does NOT fade: selected chips keep full WCAG AA contrast on the muted box, because a disabled multiselect is used for LOCKED, READABLE content; only the chip remove buttons are not rendered. For an editable-but-blocked field prefer a validation error over Disabled.

parameters.name: Required
parameters.description: Marks the field as required.

parameters.name: AllowFiltering
parameters.description: Enables the search input in the dropdown. Default: true.

parameters.name: FilterPlaceholder
parameters.description: Placeholder for the filter input.

parameters.name: Debounce
parameters.description: Debounce delay in ms for server-side filtering. Default: 300.

parameters.name: MaxSelectionCount
parameters.description: Maximum selectable items. 0 = unlimited.

parameters.name: ShowSelectAll
parameters.description: Shows Select All / Deselect All control.

parameters.name: HideSelectedItems
parameters.description: Hides already-selected items from the dropdown.

parameters.name: ShowClearButton
parameters.description: Shows a clear-all button. Default: true.

parameters.name: ShowConfirmButton
parameters.description: Shows a confirmation button in the dropdown footer to close the popup. Default: false.

parameters.name: ShowCheckBox
parameters.description: Shows checkboxes next to items.

parameters.name: SingleSelection
parameters.description: Turns the control into a SINGLE-value combobox while keeping this component's keyboard model, its async DataProvider and its chips: picking an option REPLACES the selection, closes the popup and returns focus to the trigger, the listbox announces aria-multiselectable="false", and the select-all / confirm controls are not rendered. The value still flows through Values/ValuesChanged (a zero-or-one element list).

parameters.name: HighlightMatches
parameters.description: Wraps the part of every option's display text that matches the filter in <mark>, so a reader sees WHERE the term hit. Default false, so an existing multi-select keeps rendering plain text. The match ignores casing and diacritics ("usti" highlights "Ústí") and never changes the option's accessible name, which stays the whole display text.

parameters.name: AllowCreate
parameters.description: Adds a "Create “{text}”" row at the END of the option list whenever the filter text matches no option exactly (ignoring case and surrounding whitespace). Default false. The row is the LAST role=option of the same listbox, reached with ArrowDown past the results (it becomes the aria-activedescendant and paints the same --focused style, so a sighted keyboard user sees the highlight move onto it) and picked with Enter. Picking it raises OnCreate and closes the popup; the component never fabricates an item — the host adds it to Items (or through its provider) and decides whether to select it. With a DataProvider the exact-match check only sees the loaded page, so the host must still de-duplicate in OnCreate.

parameters.name: OnCreate
parameters.description: Fires with the trimmed filter text when the user picks the create row. Only reachable while AllowCreate is true. The HOST owns the result: the popup closes, the filter clears and focus returns to the trigger, so nothing confirms the action — the component renders no live region for the selection. Announce the outcome from this handler through the host's own polite live region (a status line or a toast) and select the new value so the control's visible state matches it; the live region is what guarantees the result is heard.

parameters.name: ItemTemplate
parameters.description: Custom template for each item in the dropdown.

parameters.name: ValueTemplate
parameters.description: Custom template for each selected value chip.

parameters.name: NoRecordsTemplate
parameters.description: Template shown when no items match.

parameters.name: HeaderTemplate
parameters.description: Popup header content.

parameters.name: FooterTemplate
parameters.description: Popup footer content.

parameters.name: LoadingMessage
parameters.description: Loading message.

parameters.name: EmptyMessage
parameters.description: Empty results message.

parameters.name: ErrorMessage
parameters.description: Error message.

parameters.name: OnOpen
parameters.description: Fires when the dropdown opens.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Fires when the dropdown closes.

parameters.name: OnFiltering
parameters.description: Fires when the filter text changes.

usedAbstractions.name: IDropdownDataProvider<TItem>
usedAbstractions.description: Server-side data provider for fetching items dynamically

usedAbstractions.name: DropdownSearchRequest
usedAbstractions.description: Request parameters passed to the data provider

usedAbstractions.name: DropdownDataResult<TItem>
usedAbstractions.description: Result returned by the data provider

examples.title: Basic multi-select with chips
examples.code: <TmMultiSelect TItem="TagDto" TValue="int" @bind-Values="selectedTagIds" Items="@tags" DisplayField="@(t => t.Name)" ValueField="@(t => t.Id)" Label="Tags" Placeholder="Select tags..." />

examples.title: Checkbox mode with select all
examples.code: <TmMultiSelect TItem="UserDto" TValue="Guid" @bind-Values="selectedUserIds" Items="@users" DisplayField="@(u => u.FullName)" ValueField="@(u => u.Id)" Mode="MultiSelectMode.CheckBox" ShowSelectAll="true" MaxSelectionCount="5" Label="Assign Users" />

examples.title: Server-side data provider with grouping
examples.code: <TmMultiSelect TItem="ProductDto" TValue="int" @bind-Values="productIds" DataProvider="@productProvider" DisplayField="@(p => p.Name)" ValueField="@(p => p.Id)" GroupField="@(p => p.Category)" AllowFiltering="true" Label="Products" />

examples.title: Checkbox mode with confirm button
examples.code: <TmMultiSelect TItem="SelectOption<string>" TValue="string" @bind-Values="selectedValues" Items="@options" DisplayField="@(o => o.Label)" ValueField="@(o => o.Value)" Mode="MultiSelectMode.CheckBox" ShowSelectAll="true" ShowConfirmButton="true" Label="Technologies" />
